name: tins-native
description: Native library builds (FFTW, OpenBLAS, PocketFFT) backing the TINS.Native.<rid> (OpenBLAS + PocketFFT shim, BSD-3-Clause) and TINS.Native.FFTW.<rid> (FFTW, GPL-2.0-or-later, opt-in) NuGet package families. All three are resolved from one manifest/vcpkg install per RID; the license split happens at staging/packing time, not here. pocketfft itself is header-only -- vcpkg just vendors pocketfft_hdronly.h for pocketfft-shim/ to build against (see scripts/build-pocketfft-shim.ps1), it isn't staged/packed directly.
